name: Dragon-killer king
description: The man who killed Merrevia Sal and ruled the dragon-killers' kingdom; killed by his second wife after Bolas poisoned her with words.

description_citations.text: "Dragon-killers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dragon-killers form a kingdom ruled by Merrevia Sal's slayer, with four heirs of dragon-killer rank.
timeline.quote: The dragon-killers formed a kingdom ruled by Merrevia Sal's slayer.

citation.text: "Dragon-killers' War", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas poisons the king's second wife with words of greed and vanity; she kills her husband and marches on the other heirs.
timeline.quote: She killed her husband and marched on the other heirs.
